correctness.rationale: The null is order statistics of n independent uniform points on [0,1]², giving bounded symmetric order-3/4 U-statistics. Conditioned on z=(x,y), m3=1/3+P(x)P(y)/6, m4=1/8-P(x)P(y)/8, P(t)=6t²-6t+1, so 3(m3-1/3)+4(m4-1/8)=0 pointwise. The second canonical projection K=3(b3-m3(z)-m3(w)+θ3)+6(b4-m4(z)-m4(w)+θ4) uses exact ordered-coordinate rank placement; rational polynomial integral on x<u,y<v is 121/14400. Reversal symmetry gives ||K||²=121/3600>0. Hoeffding higher-order remainder has L2 variance O(n^-3); canonical order-two spectral U-statistic theorem gives quadratic-normal limit with variance 2||K||²=121/1800 and positive fourth cumulant 48Σ λ_j^4. Independently enumerated uniform permutations n=4,5,6 and verified exact finite variances. General non-Gaussian limit follows from analysis, not finite counts.
